title: The edge
rule: Rotor weakened by 40%. Every condition flew the fault, every learned-policy flight finished the mission, and neither no recovery nor the rule-based controller did. Every flight shown had its fault confirmed as applied by the rotor-fault plugin.

title: A needless landing
rule: Rotor weakened by 30%. The rule-based controller commanded a landing; no recovery and the learned policy both finished. Every flight shown had its fault confirmed as applied by the rotor-fault plugin.

title: Past the limit
rule: Rotor weakened by 50%. Every condition that flew the fault crashed. Every flight shown had its fault confirmed as applied by the rotor-fault plugin.

title: Wind
rule: A steady 1 newton wind (a generalization setting), rotor weakened by 40%: the learned policy finished, no recovery did not. Every flight shown had its fault confirmed as applied by the rotor-fault plugin.

title: The zigzag stall
rule: A zigzag mission never trained on (a generalization setting), healthy flights: the first training-seed-3 flight that did not finish, beside the first seed-1 flight that did.
